title: Deep neural network assesses histological inflammation in ulcerative colitis video
summary: In a prospective multicentre study of 770 patients, sensitivity was 97.9% and specificity 94.6% for histological remission, with ICC 0.927 against experts for the endoscopic score. Only 81% of biopsy sites were evaluable.
ai_technology: Deep neural network (DNUC) applied to colonoscopy video
organization: Tokyo Medical and Dental University, Japan

evidence.tested: Prospective multicentre, 770 patients, biopsy and expert reference
evidence.unknown: Evaluable in 81% of biopsy sites; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep neural network DNUC assesses histological inflammation on colonoscopy video

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
